description_en: Queries the entries of an access control list (ACL)
description_zh: 查询指定访问控制的条目
name: ListAclEntries

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

Description.description_en: The description of the ACL entry. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
Description.description_zh: 访问控制条目备注描述，长度限制为1~256个字符，允许包含字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）和下划线（_），支持中文字符

Entry.description_en: The CIDR block for the ACL entry

Status.description_en:
The status of the ACL entry. Valid values:

Adding: The ACL entry is being added.

Available: The ACL entry is added and available.

Removing: The ACL entry is being removed
Status.description_zh:
ACL条目状态，取值：
Adding：添加中。
Available：添加成功，可用状态。
Removing：移除中

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数
MaxResults.title_en: 本次查询返回记录数量
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次查询返回记录数量

NextToken.description_en:
A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that determines the start point of the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下返回的总数据记录数
